{"file_text": "from app.api import handlers

def test_handle_get_user_by_email():
    # Valid
    assert handlers.handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "ada@example.com"}) == (200, {"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"})
    
    # Missing
    assert handlers.handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "notfound@example.com"}) == (404, {"error": "not found"})
    
    # Invalid (missing email)
    assert handlers.handle_get_user_by_email({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid email"})
    
    # Invalid (not a string)
    assert handlers.handle_get_user_by_email({"email": 123}) == (400, {"error": "invalid email"})
    
    # Invalid (not a plausible email)
    assert handlers.handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "invalidemail"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid email"})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_handle_get_user_by_email()
    print("Tests passed")
", "path": "test_handlers.py"}
